subject: ID access artifacts & SAML config sync — next steps
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Taylor <sam.taylor@healthmend.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-11-03T15:10:00Z
Subject: ID access artifacts & SAML config sync — next steps

Hi Sam — thanks again for the demo earlier. Quick recap and concrete asks so we can move toward a security review and POC: 

- SOC 2 status: You mentioned a Type II in progress — can you confirm expected completion quarter and whether the SOC2 report will be shareable once final?
- Data protections: high-level confirmation that HealthMend processes PHI and requires HIPAA BA — do you have a signed BA or process to accomplish that?
- SSO/SAML provider and config: please confirm your IdP (you referenced Okta) and send an exported SAML metadata file or screenshots of the SSO app configuration.
- SCIM: you indicated SCIM provisioning is partial — can you list which attributes are provisioned and whether group sync is supported?
- RBAC / admin controls: sample admin role names and whether there is a super-admin separation (two people for approval) would be helpful.

I attached a short ID evidence checklist template to make it easier for your security team to populate the specifics (id-evidence-checklist-template.pdf). If you can send the SOC2 timeline + any artifacts and SAML metadata/screenshots before EOD Friday (11/10), we’ll prepare a tailored artifact request and timeline for controls review.

Would it make sense to schedule a 30-minute handshake call between your security lead and our security reviewer next week? If yes, propose Wed (11/15) 10:00–10:30 PST or Thu (11/16) 14:00–14:30 PST.

Thanks — Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Sales Engineering, Redwood Inference
viv@redwood.ai

--
Attachment: id-evidence-checklist-template.pdf
From: Sam Taylor <sam.taylor@healthmend.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: HealthMend IT Security <security@healthmend.com>
Date: 2028-11-04T09:17:00Z
Subject: Re: ID access artifacts & SAML config sync — next steps

Hi Vivek — appreciate the clear list. Quick responses inline: 

- SOC 2: We are mid-run for SOC 2 Type II (controls period closed 2028-09-30). CPA has draft report, target to finalize by 2028-12-15. We can share the draft under NDA now; final report once issued.
- HIPAA/BA: HealthMend is a HIPAA-covered entity; we currently execute BAs with key vendors. For Redwood, we can start the BA execution once we have a standard security addendum — want to confirm which template you prefer (we can sign Redwoods’s SAA).
- IdP / SSO: We use Okta (org: healthmend.okta.com). Attaching an exported SAML metadata XML and a zip of admin console screenshots for the App config (SSO-SAML-setup-screenshots.zip).
- SCIM: We have SCIM v2 enabled for users; current attribute sync includes: userName, givenName, familyName, email, title, department, manager. Group sync is not yet configured — roadmap Q1 2029.
- RBAC: We use three admin roles: System Admin (full), Org Admin (creates teams/users), Read-only Auditor. Super-admin separation exists in policy; two-person control for provisioning elevated privileges is documented in our internal change controls.

Attaching HealthMend_Security_Overview_2028.pdf which includes our security program summary and an extract of the provisioning policy.

I can do Wed 11/15 10:00 PST — Sam (security@healthmend.com) will join.

—Sam
Sam Taylor
VP Product, HealthMend
sam.taylor@healthmend.com

--
Attachments: HealthMend_Security_Overview_2028.pdf, SSO-SAML-setup-screenshots.zip, healthmend-saml-metadata.xml
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-11-04T10:05:00Z
Subject: Fwd: ID access artifacts & SAML config sync — next steps

Marissa / Ben — forwarding HealthMend’s responses and artifacts from Sam. Highlights: Okta + exported metadata, SCIM partial, SOC2 draft targeting 2028-12-15, HIPAA BA needed.

Action items I’d like from you both before the Wed 11/15 call: 
1) Marissa — please review the attached metadata + screenshots and confirm whether Redwood’s SAML SP config will need any custom ACS or NameID handling (I suspect Okta standard will be fine but want your call-out). Also flag any gaps in SCIM attributes vs what Redwood expects.
2) Ben — can you prepare a minimal artifact request packet we can send to HealthMend security (SOC2 draft NDA text + a clear list: SOC2 report, control matrix excerpt, BA checklist, SCIM attribute map, SAML metadata)? Attach Redwood’s IAM playbook if helpful.
3) I’ll confirm the Wed 11/15 10:00 PST slot and add security review attendees (Marissa, Ben, one runtime engineer).

Goal is to keep the artifact ask as tight as possible to avoid dragging procurement. Please respond by EOD Monday 11/13 with your drafts so I can send them to HealthMend before the call.

Vivek

On Nov 4, 2028, at 09:17, Sam Taylor <sam.taylor@healthmend.com> wrote:
> Hi Vivek — appreciate the clear list. Quick responses inline: ...
> (see HealthMend_Security_Overview_2028.pdf and SSO-SAML-setup-screenshots.zip)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-11-06T09:22:00Z
Subject: Re: Fwd: ID access artifacts & SAML config sync — next steps

Thanks Vivek — quick status from security review: 

- SAML metadata & screenshots look standard: Okta default NameID (persistent) and ACS look acceptable. I’ll run a quick SP test against their metadata during the handshake call to validate the cert chain. No custom NameID mapping expected.
- SCIM: the attribute map Sam sent is missing externalId and phoneNumber which Redwood optionally records for user binding and MFA lookup. We should request those two attributes be included if possible; explain they can be empty initially but are useful.
- SOC2: draft timeframe is fine. We will ask for the Trust Services Criteria matrix excerpt (control IDs and which controls map to encryption, access controls, change management). We will also request the CPA contact for validation under NDA.
- HIPAA / BA: Ben — please prepare Redwood’s standard BA + SAA template and a one-page BA checklist to speed exec signatures. Ben, include the operational owner (security@redwood.ai) for contract routing.

I attached our redwood_iam_playbook_v2.pdf excerpt to the outgoing request and will draft a short artifact email we can send after you finalize the BA template. I’ll also draft two bullet items to add to the HubSpot ticket for the security reviewer to track.

I’ll aim to have the draft artifact request out to HealthMend by EOD Monday 11/13.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Sr. Security Engineer, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai

--
Attachment: redwood_iam_playbook_v2.pdf
